items.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: I did a gig with a Brazilian singer not too long ago

ctx.x: Let me ask you about these jazz parties for a moment. It’s a pretty desirable thing to have in your plate of gigs?

Oh, yeah, by all means. Strictly for the chance to meet people who comprise the jazz audience, that’s one thing, but the main thing is the quality of the musicians. You come to a thing like this, and you know that everyone that you’re going to be playing with is at a certain level, because you think about the axiom that a band is only as good as its worst player, which I believe to be true, given that being an accurate axiom, the lowest level of musicianship here is very high so you are never in a situation where…
Is there a live music scene where you live in Florida of any extent?
